settings.enabledDesc: When on, the AI receptionist answers calls on behalf of your business.
settings.languageDesc: The receptionist greets and talks to callers in this language.
settings.detectDesc: If the caller speaks another language (English, German, Croatian, Italian), the receptionist switches to it.
settings.thresholdDesc: You'll be notified when your balance drops below this amount.
settings.greetingDesc: Optional. If left empty, the default greeting in the chosen language is used.
settings.greetingStyleDesc: The first sentence decides whether a caller stays on the line. The assistant says your business name first and that she is a digital assistant, as the law (AI Act) requires.
settings.greetingNameDesc: How you answer the phone, e.g. "Salon Maja". If empty, the company name without d.o.o. or s.p.
settings.assistantNameDesc: Optional. Without a name she says "I'm the digital assistant."
settings.greetingPreviewHint: In the morning she says "good morning", in the evening "good evening". Callers in another language are greeted in theirs.
settings.beforeBookingDesc: What the assistant asks before booking an appointment and what she advises the customer to prepare. For every service or only chosen ones.
settings.questionsDesc: Asked one by one before booking; the answers go into the appointment note.
settings.questionsPlaceholder: e.g. Are you allergic to hair dye?
settings.adviceDesc: Told to the customer after booking and when they ask what to know before the visit.
settings.advicePlaceholder: e.g. Please come with freshly washed hair.
settings.recordingDesc: Callers must be told the call is recorded and transcribed. The receptionist says this before the greeting.
settings.recordingOffWarning: Without a notice you may not record or transcribe calls (GDPR; in Germany and Italy it's a criminal offence).
settings.instructionsDesc: What the assistant should know beyond services and staff: FAQs, parking, payment, cancellation rules. If left empty, it uses the Chatbot+ instructions.
settings.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g.: Free parking behind the building. We accept cash or card. Cancel at least 24 hours ahead.
settings.transferDesc: When a caller wants to speak to someone, the assistant transfers the call to your number. It only transfers during opening hours (the company schedule); outside them it offers to take a message.
settings.transferNumberMissing: Without a number the assistant won't transfer calls.
settings.smsConfirmationDesc: The customer gets the booking confirmation by SMS, counted against the company's SMS quota. The text is your own confirmation template from the booking settings (and its English version), otherwise a default text in the call's language. The assistant then doesn't ask for an email. If you turn this off or run out of SMS, it asks for an email and the confirmation goes by email.
settings.ownerAlertDesc: A text to your phone when a call needs your attention: the caller asks for a callback or leaves a message, doesn't finish a booking, or the booking runs into a problem. One SMS per such call, counted against the company's SMS quota.
settings.ownerAlertPhoneDesc: If empty, the alert goes to the company's contact phone.
settings.instructionsSuggestUrlPlaceholder: Website (empty = the one in company details)
settings.instructionsSuggestTitle: Suggestion from the website. Review it; it goes into the instructions only when you click Add.

instructionsSuggestError.no_website: There is no website in the company details. Enter its address above.
instructionsSuggestError.unreachable: The website couldn't be read. Please write the instructions yourself.
instructionsSuggestError.empty: The website has too little text. Please write the instructions yourself.
instructionsSuggestError.nothing_useful: The website has nothing for the instructions (e.g. parking, payment, cancellation rules). Please write them yourself.
instructionsSuggestError.not_configured: This feature isn't set up yet.
instructionsSuggestError.model_failed: The suggestion couldn't be prepared right now. Please try again.
instructionsSuggestError.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

calls.emptyHint: Calls will appear here once the AI receptionist answers them.

credits.checkoutError: Couldn't start the payment. Please try again.
credits.checkoutSuccess: Payment successful. Credits will be added in a moment.

notActivated.title: ReceptionistPlus is not activated
notActivated.body: Turn on the AI receptionist for your business and get 30 free trial credits.
